scientific_question: Does a caption-mediated WMA adapter preserve Hindsight 0.9.2 retain, recall, memory browsing, official scoring, and persistence semantics without invoking its answer-generating reflect path?
decision_informed: Whether Hindsight is eligible for a separately frozen embedded-service lifecycle check before numerical WMA reproduction.
scientific_evidence_role: Static adapter design and mock-boundary evidence only; no package import, pg0 start, model load, lifecycle, numerical, superiority, or SOTA claim is eligible.

local_source_archive.role: accepted execution-source copy for offline adapter development

official_api_mapping.reset: Start HindsightServer on loopback with one fresh named pg0 instance under the process HOME and create one fresh bank with all official default memory and retrieval mechanisms explicitly enabled.
official_api_mapping.ingest_turn: Buffer ordered normalized turns and append attachment caption, type, and image_id as text provenance; never pass image bytes or paths.
official_api_mapping.end_session: Call retain_batch exactly once per WMA session with one item per user/assistant pair, synchronous processing, original timestamp, session document_id, metadata, and tags.
official_api_mapping.snapshot_memories: Use only paginated list_memories, require stable total and unique IDs, and never query PostgreSQL internals.
official_api_mapping.retrieve: Call recall with official budget=mid, max_tokens=4096, trace=true and default arms; truncate the already-ranked results to WMA top_k and preserve finite RecallScores.final values.
official_api_mapping.reload_from_disk: Stop client and embedded server cleanly, restart the same named pg0 instance, reconnect without recreating the bank, then let lifecycle tests verify stable snapshot/retrieval evidence.
official_api_mapping.export_memory_delta: Diff complete official memory snapshots by backend ID.
official_api_mapping.final_answer: Never call reflect; normalized recall items go to the common frozen WMA answer generator.

service_and_storage_contract.port: one auto-selected loopback port per unit process
service_and_storage_contract.storage_isolation: HINDSIGHT_STORAGE_ROOT must exactly equal process HOME; pg0 data therefore remains under the fresh project-owned unit root.
service_and_storage_contract.clean_shutdown: client.close then server.stop; atexit is an idempotent fallback only

model_and_backbone_contract.retain_and_consolidation_llm: shared frozen Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct endpoint; disclosed matched-backbone substitution for local reproduction
model_and_backbone_contract.embedding: official BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 family at the frozen local revision, local provider, CPU, offline, trust_remote_code=false
model_and_backbone_contract.reranker: official cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 canonical snapshot for the upstream alias, local provider, CPU, FP16=false, offline, trust_remote_code=false

static_acceptance: Five mock-boundary tests pass for caption provenance, one synchronous retain_batch per session, official final score propagation and post-recall top_k truncation, complete pagination, and reflect/native-multimodal exclusion.
Adapter and registration overlay import through the external WMA adapter boundary without modifying WorldMemArena source.
Every missing source/model/environment identity and every swallowed or non-finite result fails closed.
authorization_gate: This design is not executable. Lifecycle execution requires accepted wheelhouse, accepted offline-installed isolated environment, both accepted model snapshots, exact execution-source evidence, a fixed lifecycle fixture, endpoint identity, and a fresh-root/process preflight bound by a successor prefreeze.
next_gate_after_dependencies: Build and freeze the Hindsight embedded-service lifecycle checker and wrapper, then execute it only after every dependency/model/resource gate is accepted.
prohibited_actions: starting pg0, importing runtime dependencies, loading models, or allocating a port from this design
calling reflect or substituting generated Hindsight answers into the common scoring path
disabling observations, text, temporal, graph, or reranker arms without a separately named control
crediting caption-mediated text as native multimodal memory
using a shared HOME, database, environment, model target, or mutable upstream source
populating a numerical comparison-table cell or making a superiority/SOTA claim
